reason: Despite the 'docs' title, this renames public property IndexeIds->IndexIds and recipe step key IndexingProfile->CreateOrUpdateIndexProfile, which would break existing recipes/deployment plans if the Indexing module were already released, but it appears to be part of the unreleased 3.0.0 feature (per docs/releases/3.0.0.md) so impact on production sites is limited.
